\begin{chapstatus}{The thread of this chapter}
The number 0x00130313 of Lecture 02 can now be read field by field, and the processor that fetches it can be interrupted and resumed. Next: the devices that the processor serves.
\par\medskip\textbf{Exit ticket} (two to four minutes, alone, on paper):
\begin{enumerate}[nosep,leftmargin=2em]
\item Name the addressing mode of: the 1 in addi t1, t1, 1; the word read by lw t1, 8(sp); the target of beq t0, t1, loop; the operand t0 of add t2, t0, t1.
\item An interrupt arrives while the processor is executing an instruction. What happens to that instruction, which register remembers where to resume, and how does the handler end?
\end{enumerate}
\end{chapstatus}
